evidence.observation: Slow steady upward creep (~0.7 °C over 20 min) with stable profile, consistent with normal batch progression
Head temperatures flat at ~72.6 °C, stable separation
Reflux ~0.153 L/h, distillate ~0.36 L/h, ratio steady near 2.7-2.9 with occasional isolated spikes (3.6-3.9) that do not correspond to flow changes
Differential pressures ~1.0/2.0 mbar and system pressure ~749 mbar, all steady
Reboiler reads ~396 °C, implausibly high vs column profile but constant — likely sensor scaling, not a process change

args.missing_evidence: A composition measurement (distillate/bottoms sample analysis) is needed; also verification of T701's calibration/scaling.
